references.authors: Shaner NC, Campbell RE, Steinbach PA, Giepmans BN, Palmer AE, Tsien RY
references.title: Improved monomeric red, orange and yellow fluorescent proteins derived from Discosoma sp. red fluorescent protein.

provenance.sequence_source: AY678264 (synthetic construct, monomeric red fluorescent protein mCherry; Shaner et al. 2004), protein AAV52164.1, identical over 236 aa: the oldest deposit in the protein's NCBI identical-protein group. Also UniProt:A0A2U3DNX3 (canonical sequence; match, identity 1.0), verified by tools/import_uniprot_features.py. Identical to FPbase 'mCherry' (fpbase.org/protein/mcherry), which links the same GenBank protein.
